statistic: final/tension_pairs.py level (offset from A1+A2 P-free law without Z, t=0.2 s, K=2); prediction = level(X_T2) - level(X1)
decision_rule: Upper boundary (primary): for each pair compute observed delta. A hypothesis is SUPPORTED for a pair if |obs - pred| <= 0.07 (approx. 2x the largest same-type between-sample/repeat upper difference seen so far, 0.009, plus cross-session allowance) and REJECTED if |obs - pred| > 0.15. The decisive pair is D: Z and EI predict a RISE, high-mode damping predicts a FALL. Lower boundary: report only, no decision (same-type repeat yardstick 0.18-0.23 log).
note: Damping values are digitized from a raster figure (POMA Fig.1, +-3 px ~ +-4 % in zeta); C T2 lacks modes 7,10 and D T2 lacks mode 11 in the figure, so the 7-11 averages use the available modes. Same-type replicate controls to score with the same statistic once processed: A3, A4 (expect upper within +-0.03 of 0), D2 (within +-0.03 of D1 +0.172), B_T2 sample2 (within +-0.03 of +0.245).
